qr_missing_url: a QR sign-in step without a URL
missing_extension: This extension could not be found.
read_only_device: this device can only read and answer
dev_engines: A development hub build does not check engines.persona ({required})
unknown_point: contributes.{name}: this hub has no such extension point (a newer hub's?); it does not take effect
legacy_full_token: permissions.hub_api is the old way: it gets the hub's full token; ask for the scopes it uses under permissions.hub
plaintext_secret: configuration.{name} looks like a secret: it is stored and shown in plain text; declare it under secrets
protocol_version: Protocol version is {current}; the hub requires {required}
wrong_id: the program says it is "{current}", not "{required}"
wrong_version: the program says it is version "{current}", not "{required}"
attached_version: The program running on its own is version {current}; this assistant approved {approved}. It is not used until you approve that version on the hub machine (personad extension upgrade {id} <its remote: source>)
attached_package_version: The program running on its own is version {current}; the installed package is {approved}. It is not used until they match: run version {approved}, or detach it (personad extension detach {id}), upgrade the package and attach it again
attach_source: Attaching takes the program's sockets: remote:rpc=<socket>,http=<socket>
attach_not_installed: Extension {id} is not an installed package (built-in extensions and those in manager.json cannot be attached)
attach_remote_install: Extension {id} was installed from remote: and has no package; to change its sockets, upgrade it with its new remote: source
attach_no_program: Extension {id} has no program that can run on its own (no runtime, or a source runtime the hub runs)
attach_sockets: Extension {id} is reached on exactly these sockets: {sockets}
attach_unreachable: Cannot reach the program on its sockets: {err}
attached_detach_first: Extension {id} is attached; detach it first (personad extension detach {id})
install_no_database: No database: extensions cannot be installed
read_only: {id} is defined in manager.json. Edit it there or in the admin page
upgrade_not_installed: Extension {id} is not installed (built-in extensions and those in manager.json cannot be upgraded)
builtin_disable_only: {id} is built in. It can only be turned off
config_disable_only: {id} is defined in manager.json. It can only be turned off
dev_read_only: {id} is in development. Edit extension.dev.json in its directory, then run personad extension dev again
secret_not_cleared: The secret could not be deleted. Settings were not saved
secret_size: A secret must not be empty and must be at most {max} KB
secret_no_database: No database: secrets cannot be saved
secret_decrypt: Cannot decrypt secret {name} for {id} (was secret.key replaced?)
no_protocol: {name} does not speak the plugin protocol
view_invalid: The extension returned a view this app cannot display
auth_failed: Could not complete the extension’s sign-in request
sandbox_os: Sandboxes are not available on this system ({os})
sandbox_probe_dir: Cannot create the sandbox probe’s temporary directory: {err}
sandbox_mount: bwrap cannot set up the sandbox mounts: {err}
market_warning: The extension market has a warning
settings_moved: The settings changed while this was being checked. Nothing was saved; try again
translation_skipped: {file} is left out: {err}; the manifest's own text is shown instead
entry_translation_skipped: {id}: the index entry's l10n is left out: {err}; the manifest's own text is shown instead
